verify_signed_on_recv.description: Enable automatic verification of signed messages on receive

decrypt_on_recv.description: Enable automatic decryption of encrypted messages on receive

ca_dir.description: Directory containing CA certificates used to verify S/MIME certificates

cert_dir.description: Directory containing the user’s own S/MIME certificates and private keys

extra_cert_dirs.description: Additional directories to search for certificates (comma-separated when rendered)

show_cert_info.description: Enable display of certificate information (issuer, subject, validity) in message headers

ldap_cert_lookup.description: Enable automatic certificate lookup via LDAP (requires claws-mail-ldap plugin)
